story: George L. Smith State Park is a 1,634-acre Georgia state park located in Emanuel County. Its location on a 412-acre mill pond dotted with many cypress trees makes it a destination for anglers and canoeists. Rare birds in residence include the great blue heron and the white ibis.
matters: The park includes nature trails that pass through a bird sanctuary and a tortoise habitat, and features educational materials on the 15 Mile Creek watershed and estuary.
name: George L. Smith State Park
